name: questvisionstream-v2
description: V2 monorepo root: RealityCollective Service Framework (TS), com.questvisionstream streaming library, and the IWSDK Quest WebXR client. Build order matters — the framework builds before the library.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix service-framework install && npm --prefix com.questvisionstream install && npm --prefix quest-client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix service-framework run build && npm --prefix com.questvisionstream run build && npm --prefix quest-client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix service-framework run typecheck && npm --prefix com.questvisionstream run typecheck && npm --prefix quest-client run typecheck
